I chose this hotel because it was rated as a three-star property. Since it was a business trip with a team of three, I booked two rooms. However, based on my experience, this was nowhere near a three-star hotel—I wouldn’t even give it a single star.

The room itself was basic, so don’t expect anything more. Upon check-in, there was a terrible smell, and we discovered a dead rat, which we had to request them to clean. While the rooms were clean and the washrooms were acceptable, the overall experience was disappointing. The water geyser was functional, but the breakfast was subpar.

Overall, I would rate this as a below-average stay.
